To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the RMs composed with DM-β- CD-containing PU can be a promising platform for the delivery of proteins or other macromolecules.

the self-assembled PU RMs composed of the irregular segment of PEG1000/PEG2000 and DM-β- CD can be applied as a potential carrier for protein in an oil phase with good encapsulation efficiency and proper release behavior.
the RMs of PUs containing both PEG100 and PEG200 are the most promising candidates for encapsulation of protein in oleous phases with good EE and release behavior.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel PU RMs with the ability to efficiently encapsulate protein in an oleaginous phase.
the preparation of PU-based RMDs for protein delivery.
the development of a new generation of RMs composed of a series of fluorodendrimic PU-based RMs for gene delivery.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RMs of proper PUs can be used as carriers for protein with good encapsulation efficiency and proper release behavior.

the RMs composed by the irregular segments of PEGs with/without endcapped DM-β- CD entities are promising carriers for protein delivery in the oleous phase, which may be used in the field of drug delivery.
the RMs of PUs containing both PEG100 and PEG200 segments, with the end-capping of DM-βCD, can be used as carriers for protein encapsulation and delivery with high EE and proper release profile.

the RMs of proper composition and DM-β- CD-containing PU-based RMs could be promising carriers for protein or peptide delivery, especially in an oil phase.
the PU RMs can be used as carriers for proteins in an oleous environment, and the RMs with DM-β- CD-containing PU segments can be used as the most efficient carriers.
the RMs of the proper PU composition could be used as carriers for protein or peptide in an oleous system.

the RMs of proper composition and structure can be used as protein carriers in an oleous environment, and that these carriers can be used to achieve the controlled release of proteins.
the composition of PU plays a critical role in the EE, release profile and transfection efficiency.
